name: Aten Ra Sun-Seal Vigilant
loreTies: A judgment construct sworn to Ma’at balance, deployed when outsiders trespass sacred solar courts; it tests law through radiant lanes rather than cruelty.
Locks lanes and punishes deities who ignore objective geometry.
source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth
shortBackstory: Aten Ra Sun-Seal Vigilant is a lore-faithful Aten Ra run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Aten Ra Sun-Seal Vigilant belongs to The Solar Dominion of Khepra and exists to express Aten Ra law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Locks lanes and punishes deities who ignore objective geometry.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Electrum linen-light armor, Aten hand-ray aura plates, faience turquoise seals, lapis visor, obsidian counterweight blade. Abilities — Aten Ray Lattice, Ma’at Measure Bind, Solar Lane Verdict — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
